name: Conveyor Belt
summary: Belts move hay between equipment. Demo V8 reworked snapping and added automatic pathfinding; F enables No Snap Mode when you need free placement.
version: Demo V8 announcement (September 11, 2026); follow your installed build’s prompts

data.operation: Connect a short section and watch a product cross it before extending the line. A belt ending near a machine is not enough to show that the connection is working.
data.check: Work backward from the first stopped product. Check the downstream destination, each join and whether a side route bypasses scanning.

imageAlt: A conveyor carries small hay clumps from a hay pile toward the SELL HAY stand.
imageCaption: Follow the diagonal belt from the back left to its delivery point at SELL HAY. Official Steam Demo screenshot.
